name: Frilled Deathspitter
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A small bipedal hunting dinosaur with a fan of rust-orange feathers, a green-scaled snout, clawed forearms and a long tail.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), page 30.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spit Poison. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target, range 15/30 ft. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is blinded until the end of the deathspitter’s next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids blindness.
sections.At the table: At 16–30 ft., the spit attack has disadvantage for long range. While blinded, a creature cannot see, automatically fails checks requiring sight, and has disadvantage on its attacks. Attacks against it have advantage.
